rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: UKHSA guidance covers investigation and management of diphtheria cases and close contacts in England.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: The 2025 guidance is intended for health protection teams and NHS staff involved in diphtheria control.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: Public-health management can include assessment, treatment, exclusion and follow-up of cases and contacts.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: Clinically suspected respiratory diphtheria or large cutaneous lesions require prompt specialist assessment.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: Diphtheria antitoxin treatment should not be delayed when clinically indicated and should be given in hospital.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: Immunisation and infection-prevention controls are central to diphtheria prevention and control.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: Laboratory confirmation uses species identification and testing for the diphtheria toxin gene and toxin expression.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: UKHSA uses surveillance and follow-up forms for confirmed toxigenic diphtheria cases.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: Diphtheria risk depends on organism, toxigenicity, symptoms, vaccination, contact setting, antimicrobial susceptibility and response timing.

rows.source: UKHSA diphtheria public-health management
rows.verified: UKHSA diphtheria evidence is case-, organism-, contact-, setting-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: OPSS recalled a toy telephone presenting serious choking, injury, strangulation and asphyxiation risks.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: Small parts created during impact or tension testing can block a young child's airway.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: Wrist rattles were assessed as a serious choking risk when seams failed and released small parts.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: A toy piano was recalled after detachable components created small parts that fit inside the small-parts cylinder.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: A pull-along toy presented choking and strangulation risks from a small ball and an excessively long cord.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: A plush toy was recalled because detachable components created a high choking risk.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: An activity cube was recalled because a ring and key could detach and become choking hazards.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: Products presenting these hazards did not meet the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011 and were recalled or removed from marketplaces.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: Toy choking risk depends on intended age, component size, attachment strength, abuse testing, packaging, supervision and product condition.

rows.source: OPSS toy small-parts and choking safety
rows.verified: OPSS toy evidence is product-, component-, test-, child-, use- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level choking probability.
